combat.commit_target.help: while fighting a mob in reach, reflexes may pull us out but not switch us to another fight

combat.creeper_priority_range.help: range for preferring a creeper among several visible hostiles

combat.crits.help: jump before a swing so it lands as a critical hit (1.5x)

combat.deflect.help: hit a ghast's fireball back when it comes close

combat.finish_heal_wall.help: let shelter finish placing its healing wall before routine melee reflexes

combat.flee_hp.help: at or below this health, run when outnumbered (reflex and planner share it)

combat.ignore_walled_mobs.help: a close mob we failed to reach, can't see and that isn't hurting us is left alone for a minute

combat.keep_dist.help: backstep inside this distance while a melee weapon recharges

combat.no_close_retreat.help: fight or wall in within four blocks; keep retreating from nearby creepers

combat.outnumbered.help: hostiles within 6 blocks that count as outnumbered

combat.shield_guard.help: raise the shield toward a skeleton drawing its bow or a creeper about to blow

combat.skeleton_approach.help: zig-zag toward a visible skeleton, guarding with an off-hand shield

combat.skeleton_zigzag.help: ticks between direction changes during skeleton approach

combat.sprint_hit.help: sprint into the first melee hit for knockback

combat.sprint_hit_dist.help: distance at which the first sprint hit begins

combat.strafe.help: ticks between side-step direction changes while recharging; zero disables

combat.swing_at.help: attack cooldown fraction required before a melee swing

combat.target_rule.help: target nearest, most previously hit, or a nearby creeper first

combat.wall_in_anywhere.help: hurt and outnumbered: wall in and heal on the surface too, instead of running

combat.zombie_pack.help: keep space and answer the closest zombie in a pack; leave drops until the pack is gone

death.recover_value.help: go back for dropped items only when they're worth it (iron-tier+) and health 12+ or food

death.trip_commit.help: keep going for dropped items past routine fights; respond to close or multiple mobs

insights: An urgent planner option that a reflex will cancel right away does harm. It breaks off the current fight, so planner conditions must match the reflex thresholds such as reflex.melee_dist.

A skill's refusal checks must accept everything its reflex caller can hand it (reflex.melee_dist vs a hardcoded 4-block cutoff), or the reflex starts a skill that fails at once while the threat stays on us.
A progress detector keyed only on position punishes skills whose real progress is gathering items in place; check the skill's actual output before declaring stuck.
build_portal NO_ROOM failed instantly on retries because the carve fallback only tested a single room layout anchored at the bot's feet, and next to a lava pool that layout always touches the lava.

At the ocean the remembered water sources had no dry bank, so fill_bucket failed NOT_FOUND while explore water said ALREADY_DONE; a refusing skill needs the fallback a player would use (scoop from where you stand) or the planner loops between two refusals.
A retreat that starts with a monster 3-4 blocks away can't get away: the mob follows and hits our back. Fleeing only makes sense past melee range, or when we can wall in on the spot.

A reflex that checks only distance keeps restarting a fight the planner has already given up on (unreachable mark). The reflex's trigger should honour the same unreachable memory, with an exception for a mob that is really in reach.

When the planner's inventory test (Goal.have bucket counts filled buckets) says a step is ready but the skill's own check refuses, the skill must fix the state itself (pour out the spare water), or the planner offers the same refused step forever.
